# Link Style Without Shortcut References

An [inline link](https://example.com/inline) and an
![inline image](images/inline.png) in one paragraph.

A [full reference][full-ref] and a [collapsed reference][] here.

A [shortcut reference] and a ![shortcut image] here.

An autolink <https://example.com/autolink> in a paragraph.

> A quoted [inline link](https://example.com/quoted) and a
> quoted [shortcut reference].

- A listed [full reference][full-ref] item.
- A listed ![shortcut image] item.

Text in [brackets] without a definition is not a link, and
`[shortcut reference]` in a code span is code.

[full-ref]: https://example.com/full
[collapsed reference]: https://example.com/collapsed
[shortcut reference]: https://example.com/shortcut
[shortcut image]: images/shortcut.png
